description: Focuses on describing the dataset so it can be understood independently from related research products such as a published paper.
Describes the context in which the dataset was created (study goals).
Mentions the type(s) of porous media being investigated.
Addresses the research problem that the data is helping to solve (high level research question).

Address how (reproducibility, generating new studies, validation, Machine Learning, understanding porous flow, etc.) and who will benefit from reusing the data (geoscientists, water resources managers, petroleum engineers, etc.).
Describes the methodology for data collection (imaging, experimental, simulation, ML methodology that produced the data).
Provides an overview of the contents and organization of the dataset (types of files, documentation material, structure of the folder.)
Indicates if the data was quality controlled and how.
Keeps descriptions clear and accessible for experts as well as general audiences. Avoid acronyms or spell them out.
Includes porous media type, imaging method, and research methodology as keywords either explicitly or implicitly that will help others search for the data.
